notes: v4.11: Save Sale now auto-deducts the sold grams from the row's net wt (silver wt, totals and MRP all follow at once); selling more than the net wt left is refused on Save (Calculate only warns); a rapid re-save of the same grams is refused so a double-click can't deduct twice. Deleting a saved sale does not add grams back. v4.10: the frozen header moves with the body on horizontal scrolling even when the mouse is over the header strip. v4.9: Making Charge/g is Making x Total Rs/g (wastage Rs/g + labour Rs/g); the Tunch cell shows the computed purity (a typed tunch still wins and still follows a wastage override). Sell Price is the true MRP: metal = net weight x purity (tunch) / 100 x pure rate, plus customer making per gram x net weight, plus 3% GST. Cost side unchanged (silver weight by T+W, Total Amt). Update-channel build uses the compact recognizer (small detector + tiny reader): same accuracy on clean photos; very poor photos may read slightly worse than the full build. Everything from v4.7 included: fixed column shift, frozen header, PP-OCRv6 engine, rescue pass, loading bar, sell calculator, Save Sale per login with duplicates refused.
